<b>Relic Seeker Scrounge</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|Merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. She buys [[Items_(Silksong)#Tradables|relics]] in her shop in [[Bellhart]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]].

== Background ==
Relic Seeker Scrounge is a resident of [[Bellhart]] with a passion for gathering relics and a dream of keeping the entire history of the world safe inside her bellhome.<ref>Scrounge: <i>"More, then! Bring me more relics of the past! Records, seals, idols! Let's gather up the history of the world and hoard it all here, nice and safe!"</i></ref><ref>Scrounge [[Needolin]] dialogue: <i>"The past's long shadow! Whispers of the dead... Keep them safe! Keep them close... Stained by history... Relics... precious and fragile!"</i></ref> Through these artefacts, Scrounge hears the voices of bygone ages, and she has no interest in any relic that fails to speak to her.<ref>Scrounge: <i>"What occupies me, you ask? The past! The voices of ages gone by, they speak to me through what is left behind."</i></ref><ref>[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] and Scrounge dialogue: <br><i>Scrounge: "Ah! That relic you possess! A cylinder of the Citadel's sacred vault! That there is a mighty find. You will give it, yes?"<br>Hornet: "I will not, seeker. To extract what knowledge it holds, this cylinder requires a listening device, one you do not possess. If it were passed, whatever secrets it contains would remain forever hidden from us both."<br>Scrounge: "Pah... If it will not speak to me, I do not want it! Don't trouble me until you have something worth my taking!"</i></ref> Devoted entirely to her collection, she cares little for other bugs or even fellow Bellharters, considering them dullards who lack any keen sense or respect for the past.<ref>Scrounge: <i>"Those outside, those dreary pilgrims and bell-adorned dullards... none of them have my keen sense, my respect for the past!"</i></ref><ref>Hornet and Scrounge dialogue: <br><i>Scrounge: "What? What now? What's all that great racket? What is it?"<br>Hornet: "Greetings, ma'am. If you are disturbed by the rending of these lands, I fear some blame is mine to bear."<br>Scrounge: "Pah. I care not for the miseries and struggles of them outside! None of them have my keen sense, my respect for the past!"</i></ref> 

When [[Widow]] guided the [[Haunting|haunted]] thread upon the town, Scrounge remained safely indoors and was not ensnared.<ref>Hornet and Scrounge dialogue: <br><i>Scrounge: "What? What, what? Who is it? What've you got? What do you want?"<br>Hornet: "I am just a traveller, one hoping you were not too badly affected by the cursed snare set upon this town."<br>Scrounge: "Pah! What binds them outside means nothing to me. None of them have my keen sense, my respect for the past! You seem able, though. Sneaky, too. If you find any fine old stuff, anything with a history to it, bring it here. I'll take it."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
Relic Seeker Scrounge is one of the residents of [[Bellhart]]. When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] first arrives in Bellhart, Scrounge's bellhome is found closed. After [[Widow]] is defeated and the residents are freed from the [[silk]] threads, Scrounge returns to her work.

Hornet can sell different types of [[Items_(Silksong)#Tradables|relics]] to Scrounge, who translates them. After selling the relics, their translations can be viewed by speaking to Scrounge, or in the [[Bellhome]] after purchasing the [[Bellhome#Bellhome Furniture|Desk]].

{{HTalk| I am just a traveller. May I ask, though, what work occupies you here?}}<br>
What occupies me, you ask? The past! The voices of ages gone by, they speak to me through what is left behind.<br>
Those outside, those dreary pilgrims and bell-adorned dullards... none of them have my keen sense, my respect for the past!<br>
You seem able, though. Sneaky, too. If you find any fine old stuff, anything with a history to it, bring it here. I'll take it.<br>
<hr/>
